_comment: Copy to www/config.json (gitignored — never commit a key or a token). The player reads this at boot.
mapillary_token: MLY|… — OPTIONAL. Free, but the studio never creates one: paste it only if you made it yourself at mapillary.com/dashboard/developers. With it, studio/tools/panowalk/fetch.mjs can use Mapillary sequences (denser, often 360°) as well as KartaView (which needs nothing).

_images_help.what: v0.7 image treatment layer. Stills that cannot fill the frame honestly get an ambient blurred backdrop derived from the picture itself; small archive plates get a warm paper mount with a caption. Nothing is ever stretched, upscaled past its own pixels, or cropped. Per-scene override: media[].treatment = backdrop | plate | fill | none.
_images_help.plate_max_px: long side at or under this many real pixels = small archive material → the paper mount.
_images_help.fill_coverage: a contained fit covering at least this much of the frame is left alone (treatment 'fill').
_images_help.blur_px: backdrop blur radius at a 620-px-tall frame; scaled with the frame.
_images_help.drift: the slow 0.94 → 1.00 breath on a still. false, or ?drift=0 in the URL, holds every still dead still (screenshot tests, and the linear renderer when it takes over the motion).
_images_help.drift_from: where the breath starts, as a fraction of the honest size. Must be <= 1: above 1 would be upscaling.
_images_help.fallback_after_s: v0.8: a still that declares media[].fallback swaps to it after this many seconds without loading (as well as on an outright error). A picture that arrives after its authored slot has passed is as absent as one that 404s — scene 06's saloon plate is rendered on demand by archive.org's IIIF server and has ten seconds on screen. 0 disables the watchdog (errors still fall back).

_streetview_help.mode: open (our own cached open imagery → embed → link) | embed | link | js | stills. 'auto' behaves as 'open'. Per-browser override: localStorage['yy-sv-mode'].
_streetview_help.cost: open, embed and link call nothing billable. 'js' (Dynamic Street View) and 'stills' (Street View Static) are BILLABLE and are refused unless this file also sets billing_ack: true.
_streetview_help.open: needs frames cached by `node studio/tools/panowalk/fetch.mjs --chapter <chapter>`; stops with no open imagery fall back to embed, then to the card.
_streetview_help.step_m: metres of drift before the walk hops to the next pano in 'js' mode.
_streetview_help.max_stills: hard cap on Street View Static frames per scene in the 'stills' fallback (cost ceiling).
_streetview_help.resume_after_s: seconds of no touching before the auto-walk takes the camera back after a drag.
